body:
**You need to know:** both fixes are done and Harmonize runs them, but the kit commits could not be pushed to anlonlt/board (not writable from this session). They are in `docs/CL25-kit.patch`; a session with board access applies them with `git am`.

## 1. --update refreshes every installed runtime (kit 7818581)
- Bug: `.claude/hooks/kit/` was written only when `kit.runtime` is local/claude/both; Harmonize says `agy`, so its live Claude Code hooks went stale (`kit_pre_compact.py` from 2e74fce) or were copied by hand.
- Fix: a runtime is installed when its hooks dir is there (`.agents/hooks/kit/`, `.claude/hooks/kit/`), whatever runtime/cli say. Its kit files present there are refreshed; nothing is added (no new hook, no settings.json); an absent runtime is never installed (CL22). A file equal to a past committed kit version counts as a stale kit copy; a project's own change stays KEPT.
- Red on 0cf62ca: `FAIL test_stale_claude_hooks_refreshed_under_cli_agy` ('nothing to change'). Green after: 2 of 2.

## 2. step new on an attached board's train (kit 6cbd316, the orchestrator's added scope)
- `kit.py step new --board <id>` (TaskCreate metadata `board`), or with no flag the one attached board holding the train when the host has none of it.
- The post goes to `.kit/run/artifact/out/repos/<id>/posts/<pid>.json`; step new prints the one ArtifactData `set` that sends it. The orchestrator guard passes that file and still refuses the same post written by hand (tested). An existing step there is adopted (before: CL24 would have been duplicated on the host).
- Red on 7818581: 3 of 4 fail. Green after: 4 of 4.

## Harmonize
`install.py --update` from the fixed kit: dee69211 (`kit_pre_compact.py`, CL9b's `.kit/kit.py`, `.kit/BOARD.md`, `.kit/claude-cli/part.md`), bf913675 (`kit_task_train.py` in both runtimes, `.kit/kit.py`). No KEPT file. The board page did not change: no republish.

## Board
This post first went to Harmonize's own `posts` by mistake; it is now here in `repos/board/posts`, and the misplaced copy is deleted.

title: CL25: install.py --update refreshes every installed runtime
